name: SMC-CFG (tanh, blurred, noise space)
plain: A smoothed version aimed at avoiding speckle: tanh in place of sign, a 5×5 box blur on the correction, and a K scaled down by √cfg. Works on x−x̂ divided by sigma, with a warm-up that returns cond alone.
math:
e = (c−u)/σ
S = (e−ẽ) + λ·ẽ; K' = K/√max(s,1)
u_sw = −K'·tanh(S/max(std(S),1e-6)); u_sw ← avg_pool5×5(u_sw)
f = u + s·(e + u_sw)·σ
Stores raw e. Warm-up steps: f = c. Resets if sigma rises >10%.
